PreInvocation.command: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command try { if ($env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR) { & (Join-Path $env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR emit-hook.ps1) -CliSource antigravity -Event agent.prompt.submit } else { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source antigravity --event agent.prompt.submit } } catch { }; [Console]::Out.WriteLine('{}'); exit 0

hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command try { if ($env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR) { & (Join-Path $env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR emit-hook.ps1) -CliSource antigravity -Event agent.tool.starting } else { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source antigravity --event agent.tool.starting } } catch { }; [Console]::Out.WriteLine('{"decision":"ask"}'); exit 0

Stop.command: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command try { if ($env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR) { & (Join-Path $env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR emit-hook.ps1) -CliSource antigravity -Event agent.stop } else { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source antigravity --event agent.stop } } catch { }; [Console]::Out.WriteLine('{}'); exit 0
